extracted.name: Goat Cheese Sauce
extracted.description: This goat cheese sauce recipe is to be used with recipes like scalloped potatoes or macaroni and cheese which call for a cheese sauce.
ingredient_lines: 2 cups milk, or more to taste, divided
1 (4 ounce) package chive and onion-flavored goat cheese
instruction_lines: Heat oil in a saucepan over medium heat; add onion and season with a pinch of salt. Cook and stir onion until translucent, about 5 minutes. Stir flour with the onion; cook, stirring continually, for 1 minute.

Pour 1 cup milk into the saucepan while stirring; add goat cheese and stir to melt. Stir remaining milk into the mixture, 1/2 cup at a time, and cook until you reach your desired texture, 5 to 10 minutes more; season with 1/2 teaspoon salt and black pepper.
